title: A twitching swordfish
summary: Weaken the twitching swordfish so the ranger can attempt a capture.
overview: Weaken the twitching swordfish so the ranger can attempt a capture.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Stop excessive damage below 25% while the ranger maintains the required weapon.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Entering combat sets a 25% health trigger.
Below that trigger, a check every 15 seconds has a one-in-four chance to inspect damaging rangers with the required capture weapon in their primary slot.
A successful capture grants the quest result and depops the fish. Killing it instead casts Epidermal Rot.

notes: Approval E287. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
